About: Independent, authorized US dealership selling TARA electric medium speed vehicles (MSVs), and electric utility vehicles. Sales, service, financing, and warranty support for golf courses, resorts, gated communities, and private owners. We are not TARA, the manufacturer.
Vehicle lines:

- T3 Street Legal Series: T3 2+2, Rambler, Rambler SE, Vogue 2+2, Vogue — street-legal MSVs for communities
Financing: 0% APR options, six lending partners, low monthly payments — https://taramsv.com/financing/
